description: Deployment configuration for Memory API SFTP deployment

notes.uploads: Only uploads/.htaccess is deployed for security. User files are not transferred.
notes.logs: Created empty on server. Application will auto-create log files with proper permissions.
notes.vendor: Built locally with 'composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader' before deployment.
notes.static: Pre-built Next.js frontend files. Entire directory is deployed.
notes.env: Never deploy .env files. Create .env manually on server using .env.production.example as reference.
